description: This file contains a test class 'STSchedulerLongTurnTest' that verifies Orleans scheduler behavior when handling long-running grain operations to prevent timeouts and queue blocking. It sets up grains, activates them, dispatches long method calls, and asserts on execution time and absence of timeouts.

classes.name: STSchedulerLongTurnTest
classes.description: A unit test class that checks the Orleans scheduler's ability to handle long-running grain operations without causing timeouts or blocking.

methods.name: SCHED_LongTurnTest
methods.description: The main test method executing the long turn scheduling scenario, activating grains, sending long requests, and asserting the total execution time and absence of timeouts.
